name: agent-dash
description: Claude Code mod that shows which agents are working, who delegated to whom and who is waiting, with an opt-in subagent model policy.

longWaitMs.title: Long wait threshold (ms)
longWaitMs.description: Report a wait as long once it lasts this many milliseconds.

modelPolicyEnabled.title: Apply the subagent model policy
modelPolicyEnabled.description: Rewrite the model of a subagent spawn that names none, by subagent type. Off by default.

modelPolicyMap.title: Model policy map (JSON)
modelPolicyMap.description: JSON object mapping a subagent type to opus, sonnet or haiku. Empty uses the built-in map.
